messages.author: eb1bc5d8c49bfec7
messages.subject: Polygon detectors and spatial covariates
parts:
I have been using the Polygon Detector for modeling, and have had no issues running models with models specified for g0 and sigma. However, I'm not able to run models for D~ with various covariates. Initially I had run my data with 'count', and my raster covariates worked fine, but now with the polygon detector, my models won't run. Has anyone had this issue, or is familiar with polygon detectors?

I bring in my perimeter(trap) points and my capture points, and I discretize the data to a count detector:
wsarMaleCH <- read.capthist('captXY_Male_wsar.txt', 'perimeter_wsar.txt', fmt = 'XY', detector = "polygon")
traps <- read.traps('perimeter_wsar.txt', detector = 'polygon')
discreteMaleCH <- discretize(wsarMaleCH, spacing = 2500, outputdetector = 'count')

I then create a mask using a 'trapbuffer' around the perimeter points:
wsarmask <- make.mask(traps, buffer = 15000, type = 'trapbuffer')

I then bring in my raster data. This is how I added my raster data to my mask when I was using the count detector, so I may not be doing this correctly for the polygon detector:
buffer_raw <- raster("Dist_500mbuffer.tif", verbose = FALSE)
buffer_r <- scale(buffer_raw, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
buffer <- as(buffer_r, "SpatialGridDataFrame")
names(buffer) <- "buffer"
wsarmask <- addCovariates(wsarmask, buffer)

I attempt running the model with this mask specified and D~buffer, but continually get the same errors:
male.buffer.g0.T.B.s.T.B.15000.hex <- secr.fit(discreteMaleCH, mask = wsarmask, model = list(D~buffer, g0~T+B, sigma~T+B), trace = FALSE, method = 'BFGS', detectfn = 'HEX')
Error in D.designdata(mask, model$D, grouplevels, sessionlevels, sessioncov) :
  buffer not found
Calls: secr.fit -> D.designdata
Execution halted

How do I correctly add my covariates to a mask and use that covariate for modeling D?

Thanks,
Sam

parts:
Hi Murray, 

I ran the model (took several hours), but I am still getting errors. It says "beta vector" and then repeats many times.

This is the code I used, I had offline help from another member of the group, where she suggested using shapefiles rather than rasters, but it's still not working:

library(rgdal)
library(raster)
library(secr)

wsarMaleCH <- read.capthist('captXY_Male_wsar.txt', 'perimeter_wsar.txt', fmt = 'XY', detector = "polygon")
traps <- read.traps('perimeter_wsar.txt', detector = 'polygon')
discreteMaleCH <- discretize(wsarMaleCH, spacing = 2500, outputdetector = 'count')

buffer <- rgdal::readOGR("Dist_500mBuffer.shp", layer = "Dist_500mBuffer")
studyarea <- rgdal::readOGR(dsn = "WSAR_studyareaLCC.shp", layer = "WSAR_studyareaLCC") 
malebuffer <- rgdal::readOGR(dsn = "malebuffer.shp", layer = "malebuffer") 
wsarmask <- make.mask(traps, spacing = 2500, type = 'polygon', poly = malebuffer, poly.habitat = TRUE, keep.poly = TRUE, check.poly = TRUE)
wsarmask <- addCovariates(wsarmask, buffer)
plot(wsarmask, covariate = 'buffer', dots = FALSE)

summary(wsarmask)
plot(wsarmask)
plot(buffer, add = TRUE)
male.buffer.g0tb.stb.15000.hex <- secr.fit(discreteMaleCH, model = list(D~buffer, g0~t+b, sigma~t+b), mask = wsarmask, detectfn = 'HEX', method = 'BFGS', trace = FALSE)
save(male.buffer.g0tb.stb.15000.hex, file="./male.buffer.g0tb.stb.15000.hex.Rdata")


I think I did have an error previously in my mask, I didn't specify it as a 'polygon' type, but this still doesn't seem to be working. I used your suggestion of testing plot(wsarmask, covariate = 'buffer', dots = FALSE), but that works correctly and plots in Rstudio.

Should I be trying to run a null model? I've run into the beta vector error a few times now, not sure how to move forward if none of the covariate models seem to run.
